subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: The tracker shall maintain a governed signal (label) vocabulary — each signal having a name, a role (routing, authorization, status, or classification), and presentation attributes — and shall add or remove a signal on a work item idempotently.
rationale: signals are typed control state (routing, authorization, status, classification), not decoration (GOV-5)
fit_criterion: the defined vocabulary round-trips; add/remove are idempotent; adding an undefined signal is a named error
